preview.synopsis: Evenly matched sides who drew 1-1 earlier this season, both teams scoring in all five recent meetings. AI stats preview with no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Eighth in the East on 46 points (13-7-14), two wins, two draws and a loss in the last five, a 1-0 win last time out and unbeaten in seven at home. Creates many big chances and through-balls; Martin Ojeda top scorer, Griezmann has 14 goals. Braian Ojeda and Cartagena doubtful.
strengths.away: Ninth on 46 points (12-10-12), three wins in the last five but a 2-0 home loss last time; unbeaten in three away. Good shot accuracy and box touches but the second-worst xGA (1.98 per match). Evander has 14 goals and 13 assists.

preview.synopsis: RSL arrive in better recent form while Seattle have the home record and head-to-head edge. AI stats preview with no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Eighth in the West on 46 points, one win in the last five and conceding 2.0 per game in that run; worst big-chance conversion in the league. Unbeaten at home against RSL since 2023 and won 2-0 earlier this season. Morris and Musovski out; Rusnak has 12 assists.
strengths.away: Ninth on 45 points, four wins in the last five, scoring 2.2 and conceding 1.0 per game recently; Solans top scorer with 15 goals, Guilavogui in form. Yellow-card prone (37).
